21053.overview:
For ten years you've trained to be a Ninja. And now your Master tells you that it's time to take the final, most difficult test and become a Master Ninja. You must complete the game of death. You must play nine holes of... Ninja Golf?

You knew your Master was a bit weird, but nothing prepared you for this! You must attempt to sneak in a birdie between karate kicks while you battle Ninja opponents. Par for this course means leaving the green littered with fallen foes.

You gain points for both your golf game and defeating attacking Ninja. You can also earn points for finding treasures and other bonus items along the course.

Once you've completed all nine holes successfully, be ready to challenge the disguised Master Ninja. This final battle will determine whether or not you become a Master Ninja. And if you win, it will improve your golf score.

473647.overview: On a daring mission to save an energy-starved Earth, you must navigate your Starship through a complex matrix of precious solar-cells. The faster you clear the matrix, the greater your reward! Ominous Sentinels oscillate along the perimeter and riddle the energy field with fireballs. Their slightest touch will reduce your ship to ashes. Defenseless, you must weave in and out of their path until the last solar-cell is secured! The action gets hotter and hotter as you encounter more dangerous and devious solar-cell matrixes. But the supreme test awaits you in the mysterious Challenge Racks, where expert skill will enable you to learn the ultimate secret of your mission! Can you endure to the end... if there ever is one?

478739.overview:
Naughty Boy is a top-down scrolling arcade maze game. You control a "naughty boy" who is armed with stones which he can throw and are particularly destructive when they land. You can hold down the button while throwing to make the stone travel further. Your goal is to reach the end of the level at the top of the screen and destroy the flags decorating the enemy's fortress. While doing this, you must avoid creatures of various sorts including ghosts, robots, and fire-breathing dragons that may emerge from nearby swamps. Once the flags are destroyed, the castle catches fire and the next level begins.

Bonuses in the form of fruit may occasionally appear, and may be captured by landing a rock on them. Special bonuses, represented by question marks, will cause all of the enemies on screen to become afraid and unable to harm you for a short period of time. Some of the levels also require you to destroy some of the terrain (such as barbed wire or defensive walls) that are blocking your way.

Every two levels, there is a bonus round where you are flying a balloon overhead and can drop items on the monster running around beneath you for points. The bonus round ends when your balloon runs out of fuel. There are a total of four level maps, after which the game repeats at a higher difficulty.
